## Description

Describe what changed and why. Include the affected dictionary entry IDs.

## Pre-submission Checklist

- [ ] Checked for an existing issue or pull request covering this change.
- [ ] Used a separate branch, such as `fix/`, `feature/`, or `refactor/`.
- [ ] Used a descriptive Conventional Commit title.
- [ ] Read the
      [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/nikkeyl/jeosif/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Evidence

For dictionary changes, link sources for the specific sense, reading,
register, or accent. Include authors, licenses, and source IDs for reused
text. Disclose AI assistance and explain how the claims were checked.

## Checks

- [ ] The existing `Check` workflow passed, including official Yomitan
      schemas.
- [ ] Preserved source attribution and existing senses.
- [ ] For export or update changes, checked the affected behavior in Yomitan
      and Naminori where supported; record client versions and results
      below.

## Related Issues

Use `Closes #123` when this pull request resolves an existing issue.
